source='''def transform(grid):
    """Complete horizontal mirror-pairs of motifs in neighboring tiles."""
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    divider = next((v for v in range(1, 10)
                    if any(all(x == v for x in row) for row in g)), None)
    if divider is None:
        return g
    row_bars = [r for r, row in enumerate(g) if all(x == divider for x in row)]
    col_bars = [c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c] == divider for r in range(h))]
    row_spans = []
    start = 0
    for r in row_bars:
        row_spans.append((start, r))
        start = r + 1
    row_spans.append((start, h))
    col_spans = []
    start = 0
    for c in col_bars:
        col_spans.append((start, c))
        start = c + 1
    col_spans.append((start, w))

    def tile(i, j):
        r0, r1 = row_spans[i]
        c0, c1 = col_spans[j]
        return [row[c0:c1] for row in g[r0:r1]]

    def has_mark(t):
        return any(v not in (0, divider) for row in t for v in row)

    def reflected(t):
        return [row[::-1] for row in t]

    def same(a, b):
        return a == b

    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_spans):
        tiles = [tile(ri, ci) for ci in range(len(col_spans))]
        occupied = [has_mark(t) for t in tiles]
        paired = [False] * len(tiles)
        # Existing adjacent mirror matches are complete pairs.
        for ci in range(len(tiles) - 1):
            if occupied[ci] and occupied[ci + 1] and same(reflected(tiles[ci]), tiles[ci + 1]):
                paired[ci] = paired[ci + 1] = True
        # An unmatched motif gets its mirror in the next empty tile; at the
        # right edge, use the previous empty tile.
        for ci in range(len(tiles)):
            if not occupied[ci] or paired[ci]:
                continue
            target = None
            if ci + 1 < len(tiles) and not occupied[ci + 1]:
                target = ci + 1
            elif ci > 0 and not occupied[ci - 1]:
                target = ci - 1
            if target is None:
                continue
            src = tiles[ci]
            dst = reflected(src)
            tr0, tr1 = row_spans[ri]
            tc0, tc1 = col_spans[target]
            # Tile dimensions in these grids agree; clipping also handles a
            # shortened outer tile without changing the enclosing grid.
            for dr in range(min(tr1 - tr0, len(dst))):
                for dc in range(min(tc1 - tc0, len(dst[dr]))):
                    if dst[dr][dc] not in (0, divider):
                        g[tr0 + dr][tc0 + dc] = dst[dr][dc]
            occupied[target] = True
            paired[ci] = paired[target] = True
            tiles[target] = [row[:] for row in dst]
    return g
'''

def make_grid(H,W,bar,rbars,cbars, motifs):
    g=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for r in rbars: g[r]=[bar]*W
    for c in cbars:
        for r in range(H): g[r][c]=bar
    rs=[]; st=0
    for r in rbars: rs.append((st,r));st=r+1
    rs.append((st,H))
    cs=[];st=0
    for c in cbars:cs.append((st,c));st=c+1
    cs.append((st,W))
    for (ri,ci), cells in motifs.items():
        r0,r1=rs[ri]; c0,c1=cs[ci]
        for dr,dc,color in cells:
            g[r0+dr][c0+dc]=color

for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_spans):
        tiles = [tile(ri, ci) for ci in range(len(col_spans))]
        occupied = [has_mark(t) for t in tiles]
        paired = [False] * len(tiles)
        # Existing adjacent mirror matches are complete pairs.
        for ci in range(len(tiles) - 1):
            if occupied[ci] and occupied[ci + 1] and same(reflected(tiles[ci]), tiles[ci + 1]):
                paired[ci] = paired[ci + 1] = True
        # An unmatched motif gets its mirror in the next empty tile; at the
        # right edge, use the previous empty tile.
        for ci in range(len(tiles)):
            if not occupied[ci] or paired[ci]:
                continue
            target = None
            width = col_spans[ci][1] - col_spans[ci][0]
            if (ci + 1 < len(tiles) and not occupied[ci + 1]
                    and col_spans[ci + 1][1] - col_spans[ci + 1][0] == width):
                target = ci + 1
            elif (ci > 0 and not occupied[ci - 1]
                  and col_spans[ci - 1][1] - col_spans[ci - 1][0] == width):
                target = ci - 1
            if target is None:
                continue
            src = tiles[ci]
            dst = reflected(src)
            tr0, tr1 = row_spans[ri]
            tc0, tc1 = col_spans[target]
            # Tile dimensions in these grids agree; clipping also handles a
            # shortened outer tile without changing the enclosing grid.
            for dr in range(min(tr1 - tr0, len(dst))):
                for dc in range(min(tc1 - tc0, len(dst[dr]))):
                    if dst[dr][dc] not in (0, divider):
                        g[tr0 + dr][tc0 + dc] = dst[dr][dc]
            occupied[target] = True
            paired[ci] = paired[target] = True
            tiles[target] = [row[:] for row in dst]
    return g
